en.headline: Yuja Wang and Mahler Chamber Orchestra say programme change was notified weeks in advance
en.dek: In a joint statement, the pianist and orchestra said the Hong Kong organiser chose not to inform audiences until the day of the concert.
body: Pianist Yuja Wang and the Mahler Chamber Orchestra issued a joint statement on Sunday saying the programme change that led to refunds at a Hong Kong concert had been communicated weeks in advance.

The statement said the change, in which Wang performed only one work in the second programme, was not an on-the-night or impromptu decision. It had been communicated by the touring agency weeks earlier, and the Hong Kong presenter opted not to tell audiences until the day of the concert.

The organiser, Premiere Performances of Hong Kong, had previously apologised and offered full refunds after some audience members complained that the advertised Tsfasman Jazz Suite was dropped and Wang’s stage time was shorter than expected on 10 November.
Wang and the orchestra said she had engaged collaboratively throughout the process and hoped audiences would enjoy the artistic experience being created.
The concerts formed part of Premiere Performances’ 20th anniversary season at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre.

zh.headline: 王羽佳與馬勒室樂團發表聯合聲明 指節目改動已提前數周通知
zh.dek: 聲明表示，香港主辦方選擇直至演出當日才向觀眾公布有關改動。
body: 鋼琴家王羽佳與馬勒室樂團周日發表聯合聲明，指導致香港場次退款的節目改動已於數周前通知。
聲明稱，王羽佳在第二場只演奏一首作品的改動並非當晚臨時決定，巡演經紀已提前數周溝通，香港主辦方選擇直至演出當日才告知觀眾。
主辦方飛躍演奏香港早前就ᆮ1010日演出道歉並提供全額退款，部分觀眾投訴原定的齊法斯曼爵士組曲被抽起，王羽佳上台時間較預期短。
王羽佳與樂團表示她在整個過程中均有合作參與，希望觀眾享受正在創造的藝術體驗。
有關演出屬飛躍演奏香港二十周年樂季，在香港文化中心舉行。
